::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/request_logs/{id}"}
#docs
One request with its stored bodies, and what it is linked to: the other requests sent with the same `Idempotency-Key` (oldest first, the first marked `original`), and the events, audit log entries and gateway calls with its trace id. Masked values read `****`; a route that returns a one-time secret stores `{"_omitted":"secret"}`; a long value or body is cut and says so (`_omitted`, `_truncated`).

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The request id (`req_…`), as in the `Request-Id` header. |
